scope: Six separately fine-tuned policies; one nominal frame-zero episode per engine per task

expected_budget.domain_randomization: motor-v1: wheel resistance, motor no-load speed, motor torque capacity
expected_budget.selection_rule: Predesignated final checkpoint; no evaluation-based checkpoint selection; no retraining after results.
expected_budget.evaluation_domain: nominal, deterministic, starts at reference frame zero including its nonzero initial velocities
not_claimed: single policy for all six skills

limitations: Each task is a separate policy fine-tuned from the same previous jump DR checkpoint.
A completed training process or surviving until motion_end is not task success.
Behavior gates are fixed before outcomes; additional runtime scene audits only strengthen provenance.
Isaac wheel forces are net-force proxies and non-wheel ground-only force evidence is incomplete.
Videos reconstruct recorded physical rollout poses in a common renderer; they are not additional physical simulations.
Raw CMU assets, robot assets, full trajectories, logs and checkpoints are excluded from Git.
publication: Source-hash-linked compact snapshot. No raw CMU motion, robot assets, checkpoints, actor weights, full trajectories or logs redistributed. Third-party licenses remain applicable.
